text.description_html:
Brass Accents A04-K5140, Solid Brass Shell Door Knocker

Although fitting, seashell hardware doesn't only have to go on beach homes. The Shell Door Knocker is great for anyone who loves the ocean, even if they are land locked. This seashell door knocker's elegance makes a big impression. Made out of solid brass, with a Satin Nickel finish.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance. Their products are hand finished in the USA. They are one of the world's leading crafters of cast-brass and hot-forged decorative brass hardware.

Specifications for the Satin Nickel Shell Door Knocker:

  • Height: 7-7/8"
  • Mounting Centers (distance between the 2 mounting screws): 6-1/8"
  • Max Thickness: 1"
  • Max Width: 3-3/8"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Satin Nickel

No matter which finish you choose for the Sea Shell Door Knocker, it will still be solid brass material inside.

** This item is discontinued. See available Door Knockers
